summary: Preference-backed candle period with local override matches goals; tests and live checks pass. Minor typing nit on useSelector cast; restore canonical recipe runner when possible.

comments.body: Consider extending the `getPreferences` return type (or a dedicated selector) to include `perpsSelectedCandlePeriod` so this `as { perpsSelectedCandlePeriod?: string }` assertion on the `useSelector` result can be removed while keeping strict typing end-to-end.
